decisions.reason: Schlager compilations are core to the label's catalog and stay listed as backlist items for years, with little cost to keep them in the warehouse-backed shop.
An ongoing illustrated release series with several titles builds a collector following and fits the label's curated editions, so the firm is likely to continue it.
Reissued jazz vinyl serves a growing collector demand for vinyl, though a limited pressing could sell out and not be repressed.
Multi-disc box sets are a signature product for collectors, but limited editions risk going out of print once stock runs down.
A standard compilation CD costs little to keep in stock, though it was only mentioned rather than featured, and CD demand is declining.
